title: Be clear about the data you need

statement.en: Apply the documented Entering data guidance to be clear about the data you need.
statement.ja: 「Entering data」において「Be clear about the data you need」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Entering data experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Consider an expansion tooltip for clipped macOS field text

statement.en: Consider an expansion tooltip that shows the complete text when a macOS field clips or truncates it.
statement.ja: macOS fieldでtextがclippedまたはtruncatedになる場合は、全文を示すexpansion tooltipを検討する。

conditions: The field is too small to display the complete entered data.
This applies to macOS apps, including iOS and iPadOS apps running on a Mac.
The expansion tooltip appears when the pointer rests over the field.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Entering data experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるEntering dataの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
